title: City street-tree survey
summary: Each row compares a street photograph with two renders from the same frozen scene. The middle uses the canopy-height model. The right adds city tree-trunk positions, measured diameters and species when available.
measurement: In the September drive, withheld when developing the tree-matching method, mean error in the left roadside canopy boundary fell from 26.0 to 14.7 percentage points of frame height across ten columns. Tree sizes without a matching canopy peak were estimated from similar local trees. The inventory covers few private-yard trees.

images.caption: August 19 and September 9, 2025. Photographs at left, canopy model in the middle, surveyed street trees at right.
